mod.overview: Shifter_v1Y (Yukichigai's 12-06-2002 release, forked from Emo1313's 09-28-2000 Shifter via Shifter Advanced and Shifter FAMM) keeps Shifter's nine-armor class system while heavily expanding weapon and equipment customization, tightening deployable balance, and adding new weapons and server switches. Highlights include a three-mode Dart Rifle (Poison, EMP, Flare), selectable Disc Launcher (Standard / Rapid Fire), Grav Gun (Tractor, Repulse, and Grapple with optional 3D Advanced aiming), and Teleport Pack (TeleBeacon, Waypoint, and 125 m Hyperdrive) modes, plus the Arbitor-only Boomer shotgun, Mercenary Underarm 20mm HE pack, an active area-of-effect Healing Plant, and an updated Det Bug system.
notes: Server switches (Customization lines.txt and in-script defaults): $Shifter::noStimFix (turns off the Scout stim-shield cap), $Shifter::LaserMineCountLimit (default 2 in code, 3 in Customization lines), $Shifter::AirBaseRepair, $Shifter::Showmod, $Shifter::HaVoCNuke (turns HellFireModule's blast into a 30 m nuke blast), $Shifter::ShockFloors, $Shifter::RegStinger (disables high-damage RegStingerMissile), $Shifter::BoosterPacks / $Shifter::Boosters, $Shifter::LoadoutList, $Shifter::ScoreAll, $Shifter::DiscOpts, $Shifter::HeatSeeker, $Shifter::JugWeapons, $Shifter::NewPlasma, $Shifter::PlasCanLimit / $Shifter::PlasCanLimitTime, $Shifter::RegenFix, $Shifter::TelePackOpts, $Shifter::HealingPlant, $Shifter::FairPlay, $Shifter::MDMNuke, $Shifter::AllNukeLimit (15), $Shifter::LimitNukes, and $MatchConfig (forces competitive settings).

Class kit updates from Shifter 09-28-2000: Assassin's beacon key now throws a Shuriken projectile instead of a Detbomb; Juggernaught's grenade key activates an emergency shield (Renegades_StartShield) and its beacon key charges PlasmaCannon, cools Hammer1Pack when heat exceeds 35, or triggers the EnergyBelt recharge beacon (JugCharge) for 5 seconds; DreadNaught's mine key places a LaserMine (or Mortarbomb2 in Deathmatch/possessed mode); Goliath's grenade key throws Concussion1 when $MatchConfig is true.

Chemeleon infiltration (player.cs Shifter_startInfiltrate): colliding with an enemy player now temporarily switches the Chemeleon's team to mimic the target's team and drops any carried flag for roughly 30 seconds instead of only swapping skins.

Deployable rules (itemfuncs.cs deployable()): switched from 16 arguments to 15 (removing the separate no-inside flag), added a 25 m satchel proximity cap (at most 6 SatchelPacks), Grey's Laser Airbase check (refuses angled Laser Turrets on airbases with 5.2 impact damage), and a FairPlay check (when $Shifter::FairPlay is not false, turrets and EMPBeacons cannot deploy near enemy Inventory/Ammo stations or non-emplacement generators).

Status and damage updates (damage.cs, player.cs): adds $RailDamageType, $PoisonDamageType, $MagDamageType, $ELFDamageType, $AntimatterDamageType, and $GayDamageType scales across armors, tunes Goliath plasma scale to 0.2, and lets RepairKit also heal the pilot's currently mounted flier by 0.3.

Unused or incomplete datablocks in item.cs: EnergyBelt is mounted only internally by JugCharge in slot 6; MegaDiscLauncher, MegaDiscAmmo, and LJ are defined in item.cs ($WeaponList entries exist) but have zero ItemMax on any armor and are not sold in stations.

Chaingun.summary: Equalizer rotary gun with instant spin-up and higher per-bullet damage than Shifter.
notes: Unlike Shifter, spinUpTime is reduced from 0.2 to 0.0 and ChaingunBullet damageValue increases from 0.15 to 0.37.
Chaingun::onUse prints 'Using Chaingun' when $Shifter::DeathMatch is true, otherwise 'Using Equalizer'.
Chaingun.source: item.cs ChaingunImage; baseProjData.cs ChaingunBullet; itemmsgs.cs Chaingun::onUse

PlasmaGun.summary: Plasma Gun with Standard, Rapid Fire, and Spread Fire modes, unified under a single per-shot ammo spend and an optional classic bolt toggle.
notes: Unlike Shifter, PlasmaGunImage::onFire always decrements 1 ammo up front regardless of mode, supports dead-player ownership (%player.owned), and fires PlasmaBolt2 in mode 0 only when $Shifter::NewPlasma is true and $MatchConfig is not true (otherwise PlasmaBolt).
Modes 1 (Rapid) and 2 (Spread) fire PlasmaBoltRapid / PlasmaBoltMulti; mode 3 (frag-spawning PlasmaBolt2) remains in code without a menu binding.

Mortar.summary: Heavy artillery launcher with standard (including Juggernaught JuggyMortarShell), EMP, Frag, MDM (with optional dual-blast nuke), and SatchelShell modes.
notes: Unlike Shifter, mode 0 fires JuggyMortarShell when worn by a Juggernaught (jarmor) if $Shifter::JugWeapons is not false or $MatchConfig is true; otherwise MortarShell.
Mode 3 (MDM) fires DelayMortarShell and on second trigger spawns HavocBlast plus an extra HavocBlast3 when $Shifter::MDMNuke is not false or $MatchConfig is true.
Mode 4 now spawns SatchelShell (defined in baseProjData.cs) instead of the missing TacMortar.
Mortar.source: item.cs MortarImage::onFire; baseProjData.cs JuggyMortarShell, SatchelShell; blasts.cs HavocBlast, HavocBlast3

DiscLauncher.summary: Disc Launcher with a new selectable Rapid Fire mode alongside Standard fire.
notes: Unlike Shifter, DiscLauncherImage::onFire handles firing in script: mode 0 (or when $Shifter::DiscOpts is false or $MatchConfig is true) fires DiscShell; mode 1 fires DiscShell2.
DiscLauncher::onUse announces the active mode ('Standard' or 'Rapid Fire') unless $Shifter::DiscOpts is false.

LaserRifle.summary: Light-armor Laser Rifle tuned with higher energy-to-damage conversion and blue beam visuals.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: uses SniperRLaser (damageConversion 0.016 instead of 0.01, blue_blink4.bmp beam and blue lightColor).

EnergyRifle.summary: ELF Gun with higher damage per second, faster energy drain, and energy transfer back to the shooter.
notes: Unlike Shifter, uses lightningCharge (damagePerSec 0.22 vs 0.1, energyDrainPerSec 100.0 vs 60.0, damageType $ElectricityDamageType instead of $FlashDamageType).
lightningCharge::damageTarget applies 0.005 electricity damage per tick and drains 2.24 energy from the target, adding 2.24 energy to the shooter while the target still has energy.

HyperB.summary: Hyper Blaster tuned with higher bolt damage under standard Blaster damage scaling.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: HyperBolt damageValue increases from 0.05 to 0.17 and damageType changes from $HBlasterDamageType to $BlasterDamageType.

RocketAmmo.summary: Rocket Launcher ammunition renamed from 'RocketAmmo' to 'Rocket Ammo'.
notes: Display name updated to 'Rocket Ammo'; carried and consumed as in Shifter.

RocketLauncher.summary: Four-mode Rocket Launcher adding boosted RegStinger shots, sensor-jamming checks on target lock, and Heat Seeker mode alongside LockJaw and wire-guided GodHammer.
notes: Mode 0 (and mode 1 when $Shifter::LockOn is false) fires RegStingerMissile with backward kickback impulse on non-Juggernaughts unless $Shifter::RegStinger is true (when $MatchConfig is not true), in which case it fires StingerMissile.

Mode 1 (Locking) extends LOS range to 950 m, respects Chemeleon armor, SensorJammerPack, DeployableSensorJammerPack, and sensor suppression (>19), and fires JugStingerMissileTracker for Juggernaughts when $Shifter::JugWeapons is not false.

Mode 2 uses Heat Seeker (LockJaw2 / LockJaw2Fire) when $Shifter::HeatSeeker is not false or $MatchConfig is true, otherwise mounts and triggers LJ in slot 7 to paint targets for LockJawFire (MiniMissileTracker).
Mode 3 fires GodHammerMortar (sets deployer).
RocketLauncher.source: item.cs RocketImage::onFire; itemmsgs.cs RocketLauncher::onUse; baseProjData.cs RegStingerMissile, JugStingerMissileTracker, LockJaw2Fire

SniperRifle.summary: Assassin projectile Sniper Rifle with zero fire delay and full inherited velocity.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: SniperRifleImage fireTime changed from 0.08 to 0 and SniperRound inheritedVelocityScale increased from 0.8 to 1.0.

BoomStick.summary: Close-range shotgun using shotgun firing sound.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: BoomStickImage sfxFire changed to SoundFireShotgun and projectileType cleared on the image (still spawned in BoomStickImage::onFire).

TranqGun.summary: Rebuilt into a three-mode rifle (Poison Dart, EMP Dart, and Flare Dart) by mounting hidden sub-items in slot 7.
notes: Unlike Shifter's single TranqDart weapon, TranqGun::onMount and TranqGun::onUse mount TranqGun0 (Poison Dart), TranqGun1 (EMP Dart), or TranqGun2 (Flare Dart) in slot 7 according to %client.Tranq.
TranqGunImage::onFire triggers slot 7 to fire the mounted mode, and in mode 2 additionally spawns a DeCloakDart projectile.

Silencer.summary: Magnum sidearm reworked into a high-impact precision slug rifle with heavy knockback.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: SilencerBullet damageValue raised from 0.26 to 1.02, aimDeflection zeroed, muzzleVelocity 700, totalTime 0.1, mass 200, kickBackStrength 900, and purpleExp explosion.

ConCun.summary: Shockwave Cannon with minimal energy threshold and Impact damage type.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: ConCunImage minEnergy lowered from 40 to 1, and Shock damageType changed from $MissileDamageType to $ImpactDamageType.
Stat-only change from Shifter: RailRound damageType changed from $BulletDamageType to $RailDamageType, with updated blue light properties on RailgunImage.

Mfgl.summary: Tactical Nuke launcher requiring Juggernaughts to spend a Beacon or suffer containment failure.
notes: Unlike Shifter, MfglImage::onFire supports dead-player ownership (%player.owned) and checks if a Juggernaught (jarmor) carries at least one Beacon: if so it consumes one Beacon; otherwise it warns of containment failure and deals 0 to 6 random $NukeDamageType radius and direct damage to the firer.

Flamer.summary: Flame Thrower with linear bolt flight and inherited player velocity.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: FlamerBolt removes acceleration/terminalVelocity/trailString and sets inheritedVelocityScale to 0.3.

IonGun.summary: Arbitor Ion Rifle with faster firing, lower energy draw, and higher bolt damage.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: IonGunImage fireTime 0.15 (was 0.2), minEnergy 1 (was 40), maxEnergy 20 (was 30), and IonBolt damageValue 0.29 (was 0.25).

Fixit.summary: Engineer Repair-Gun with updated repairpack HUD icon.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: Fixit hudIcon changed from 'targetlaser' to 'repairpack'.

GravGun.summary: Grav Gun expanded with Grapple mode (pulling the shooter toward the target) and optional 3D Advanced aiming.
notes: Unlike Shifter's Tractor/Repulse only, GravCharge::damageTarget supports three modes: 0 Repulse, 1 Tractor, and 2 Grapple (pulls the shooter toward %target at velocity 25 using Item::setVelocity or Player::applyImpulse depending on %playerId.GravADV).

When %playerId.GravADV is non-zero, Tractor (velocity 45) and Repulse (velocity -35) pull/push along the 3D vector between shooter and target instead of player rotation; modes 0 and 1 deal electricity damage to non-teammates.
GravGun::onUse prints both the active mode and whether 'Advanced (3d)' is enabled.

Penis.summary: Punishment curse weapon with undefined image projectile cleared.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: PenisImage clears its placeholder 'Undefined' projectileType.

DeployableInvPack.summary: Deployable Inventory Station using the updated 15-argument deployable() helper with clearance check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, DeployableInvPack::deployShape drops the separate no-inside flag and enables checkDeployArea (%area True).

DeployableAmmoPack.summary: Deployable Ammo Station using the updated 15-argument deployable() helper with clearance check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, DeployableAmmoPack::deployShape enables checkDeployArea (%area True).

DeployableComPack.summary: Deployable Command Station using the updated 15-argument deployable() helper with clearance check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, DeployableComPack::deployShape enables checkDeployArea (%area True).

EnergyPack.summary: Energy Pack with validateMaterials metadata removed.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: EnergyPack drops validateMaterials.

RepairPack.summary: Repair Pack with validateMaterials metadata removed.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: RepairPack drops validateMaterials.

ShieldPack.summary: Shield Pack that prevents stacking with an active emergency shield and optionally nerfs Stim armor shielding.
notes: Unlike Shifter, ShieldPackImage::onActivate refuses activation if $ShieldTime[%client] > 0 ('Shielding already activated. Shield Pack not active.') and onDeactivate exits early while $ShieldTime is active.
For stimarmor/stimfemale, shieldStrength is capped at 0.009 unless $Shifter::noStimfix is true (and $MatchConfig is not true); otherwise 0.022.

SensorJammerPack.summary: Sensor Jammer Pack with stronger sensor suppression and slightly higher active energy drain.
notes: Unlike Shifter, increases sensor suppression added/removed from 20 to 30 and raises SensorJammerPackImage maxEnergy from 10 to 12.

CloakingDevice.summary: Cloaking Device with stronger sensor suppression and a 90-tick personal cloak alongside the CloakBlast.
notes: Unlike Shifter, increases sensor suppression added/removed from 5 to 20 (clamping at 0 on deactivate), throws the spawned CloakBlast mine, and for Arbitors also calls Renegades_startCloak with $CloakTime set to 90.

StealthShieldPack.summary: StealthShield Pack with reduced sensor suppression and emergency-shield coexistence.
notes: Unlike Shifter, sets sensor suppression delta to 10 instead of 20 (clamping at 0 on deactivate), and if $ShieldTime is active it engages stealth only without overwriting or zeroing %player.shieldStrength.

RegenerationPack.summary: Regeneration Pack / Gun with high-health structure drain protection and expanded friendly powering/shielding.
notes: Unlike Shifter, DrainBolt::checkDone removes the checkHackable rejection, skips damaging enemy targets with maxDamage >= 35 unless $Shifter::RegenFix is false (and $MatchConfig is not true), and heals the user by %damage / 25.

On friendly targets, DrainBolt::onAcquire/checkDone power unpowered base stations for $Shifter::HackedTime, add 50 energy and reduce EMP time to 2 on EMP'd teammates, apply Shifter_startShield (4-minute cooldown) or refill energy on teammates, add shields to fliers/generators/turrets, and recharge deployable stations by +1000 energy.

LightningPack.summary: Arbitor Teleport Pack expanded with three selectable modes: TeleBeacon (0), Map Waypoint (1), and 125 m Hyperdrive (2).
notes: Mode 0 (or when $Shifter::TelePackOpts is false or $MatchConfig is true) drops/teleports to a TeleBeacon within 350 m (50% flag-drop chance).
Mode 1 teleports to the player's map waypoint if at full energy (drains all energy, refuses within 50 m of a flag, 80% flag-drop chance; note: sets %zpos instead of %dpos in the initial LOS probe).
Mode 2 (Hyperdrive) teleports along the player's aim up to 125 m for 60 energy (50% flag-drop chance); onDeactivate reports status via $telemode[%client].

FlightPack.summary: Flight Pack with updated energypack HUD icon.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: FlightPack hudIcon changed to 'energypack'.

SMRPack.summary: Shoulder-mounted Auto-Rocket Pack that respects Chemeleon armor, jammer packs, and sensor suppression.
notes: Unlike Shifter's broken '||' Chemeleon check, SMRPackImage::onActivate requires non-Chemeleon armor, no SensorJammerPack/DeployableSensorJammerPack, sensor suppression <= 19, and enemy team (or $Shifter::DeathMatch) before firing StingerMissileTracker.

SMRPack2.summary: Juggernaught Auto-Rocket Pack that respects stealth/jammers and fires JugStingerMissileTracker when $Shifter::JugWeapons is active.
notes: Unlike Shifter, fixes the Chemeleon/jammer/sensor-suppression lock check and fires JugStingerMissileTracker instead of StingerMissileTracker when $Shifter::JugWeapons is not false or $MatchConfig is true.

BarragePack.summary: Anti-Aircraft Turret pack using the 15-argument deployable() signature.
notes: Unlike Shifter, BarragePack::deployShape drops the separate no-inside flag to match the 15-argument deployable() helper; behavior of BarrageTurret is otherwise unchanged.

BlastFloorPack.summary: Blast Floor pack using the 15-argument deployable() signature.
notes: Unlike Shifter, BlastFloorPack::deployShape drops the separate no-inside flag to match the 15-argument deployable() helper.

Laptop.summary: Command Laptop with clock HUD icon and periodic enemy-jammer scan removed.
notes: Unlike Shifter, LapTopImage::onActivate only sets %client.Laptop = true and no longer runs LapTopImage::check (which was removed).

SuicidePack.summary: Suicide DetPack integrated with the team nuke limit, disarm stealing, and nuclear blast on wrong-wire cut.
notes: Unlike Shifter, SuicidePack::deployShape checks $Shifter::DetPackLimit > 0 and $Nukecount[team] < $Shifter::AllNukeLimit (unless $Shifter::LimitNukes is false), consumes the pack up front, and drops SuicidePack::onUnmount.

On Suicidebomb2::onCollision, an Engineer cutting the wrong wire triggers NuclearExplosion instead of Mine::Detonate; disarming safely awards +20 score, increments enemy $Nukecount and decrements the thrower's team $Nukecount.

MotionSensorPack.summary: Motion Sensor pack using the 15-argument deployable() helper with surface check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, MotionSensorPack::deployShape enables %surface (terrain, interiors, or platforms/blast structures).

AmmoPack.summary: Ammo Pack with updated ammo drop loop covering MineAmmo and BoomAmmo.
notes: Unlike Shifter's fixed 12-item loop, AmmoPack::onDrop loops to $AmmoPackItemsNum and includes MineAmmo and BoomAmmo in the dropped ammo pack.

DeployableSensorJammerPack.summary: Deployable Sensor Jammer using the 15-argument deployable() helper with surface check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, DeployableSensorJammerPack::deployShape enables %surface (terrain, interiors, or platforms/blast structures).

CameraPack.summary: Deployable Camera using the 15-argument deployable() helper with surface check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, CameraPack::deployShape enables %surface and removes validateMaterials.

TurretPack.summary: Ion Turret pack with frequency interference check and clearance check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, TurretPack::deployShape enables %freq (no duplicate Ion Turret in the large box) and %area (checkDeployArea).

LaserPack.summary: Laser Turret pack with clearance check enabled and airbase placement guard.
notes: Unlike Shifter, LaserPack::deployShape enables %area (checkDeployArea), removes validateMaterials, and triggers deployable()'s Laser Airbase check (angled Laser Turrets on airbases fail and deal 5.2 impact damage).

DeployableElf.summary: Deployable ELF Turret pack with clearance check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, DeployableElf::deployShape enables %area (checkDeployArea).

ShockPack.summary: EMP Turret pack with surface check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, ShockPack::deployShape enables %surface (terrain, interiors, or platforms/blast structures).

TargetPack.summary: Mortar Turret pack renamed internally to 'Remote Mortar Turret' on deploy with frequency check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, TargetPack::deployShape enables %freq and passes 'Remote Mortar Turret' as the deployed object's name.

PlasmaTurretPack.summary: Plasma Turret pack with frequency interference and clearance checks enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, PlasmaTurretPack::deployShape enables %freq and %area (checkDeployArea).

RocketPack.summary: Rocket Turret pack with frequency interference check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, RocketPack::deployShape enables %freq (no duplicate Rocket Turret in the large box).

ForceFieldPack.summary: Small Force Field pack using the 15-argument deployable() signature.
notes: Unlike Shifter, ForceFieldPack::deployShape drops the separate no-inside flag to match the 15-argument deployable() helper.

LargeForceFieldPack.summary: Large Force Field pack using the 15-argument deployable() signature.
notes: Unlike Shifter, LargeForceFieldPack::deployShape drops the separate no-inside flag to match the 15-argument deployable() helper.

BlastWallPack.summary: Blast Wall pack using the 15-argument deployable() signature.
notes: Unlike Shifter, BlastWallPack::deployShape drops the separate no-inside flag to match the 15-argument deployable() helper.

HoloPack.summary: Hologram deployable pack using the generic SimSet name 'set'.
notes: Unlike Shifter, HoloPack::deployShape names its temporary SimSet 'set' instead of 'holoset'; hologram behavior is otherwise unchanged.

TreePack.summary: Mechanical Tree pack deployable on any flat surface up to 5 m away.
notes: Unlike Shifter, TreePack::deployShape increases LOS reach from 3 m to 5 m, removes the terrain-only restriction so any flat surface works, and sets the deployed tree description to 'Mechanical Tree'.

PlantPack.summary: Rewritten Healing Plant that deploys a HealingPlant turret which heals and restocks teammates on contact and damages enemies in a 35 m area.
notes: Unlike Shifter's cactus1/cactus2 props, PlantPack::deployShape deploys a single HealingPlant turret (price raised to 1350, heading 'lArea Effect Items' unless $Shifter::HealingPlant is 'false' at spawn, in which case it reverts to 500 and 'eDefensive').
HealingPlant::checkHealingPlant scans a 35x35x35 box when $Shifter::HealingPlant is not false, and HealingPlant::onCollision gives a RepairKit and full heal to teammates (and Chemeleons).
PlantPack.source: item.cs PlantPack, PlantPack::deployShape; turret.cs HealingPlant, HealingPlant::checkHealingPlant/onCollision; game.cs

PlatformPack.summary: Deployable Platform pack using the 15-argument deployable() signature.
notes: Unlike Shifter, PlatformPack::deployShape drops the separate no-inside flag to match the 15-argument deployable() helper.

TeleportPack.summary: Deployable Teleport Pad removing the inside-object test and shifting its armor block from DreadNaught to Penis armor.
notes: Unlike Shifter, TeleportPack::deployShape removes the rocket collision check and GameBase::testPosition check, DeployableTeleport::onCollision blocks harmor and parmor (allowing darmor to teleport), and DeployableTeleport::onDestroyed calls StaticShape::onDestroyed.

MechPack.summary: Interceptor Pack deploying a lighter Scout flier and counting against the ScoutVehicle team limit.
notes: Unlike Shifter, Scout FlierData lowers maxDamage from 0.8 to 0.6, lift from 1.1 to 1.07, and minSpeed from -15 to -10, and MechPack::deployShape checks and increments $TeamItemCount[team @ 'ScoutVehicle'] instead of MechPack.

DetPack.summary: Stealth HPC Pack deploying an updated HAPC transport that supports Valkyrie and GodHammer modules.
notes: Unlike Shifter, HAPC increases maxPitch from 0.5 to 1.2 and maxSpeed from 45 to 50, and HAPC::OnFire replaces the old module 7 branch with module 1 (Valkyrie RegStingerMissile) and module 10 (Godhammer).

RepairKit.summary: Repair Kit that also repairs the player's currently mounted flier and clears Det Bug infection.
notes: Unlike Shifter, RepairKit::onUse supports Admin possession, clears %clientId.lastdropper = 'Off' (removing an active Det Bug), and if mounted in a Flier repairs the vehicle by 0.3.

MineAmmo.summary: Armor-dependent mine thrower adding Deathmatch-compatible mine triggers, cloak-blast fading, and ProxMine Det Bug triggers.
notes: Unlike Shifter, DreadNaught (darmor) drops LaserMine normally (Mortarbomb2 only in Deathmatch or while possessed); Engineer EngMine 0 throws the reworked ProxMine (shaped like armorPatch, 1.5 m trigger radius) which plants a Det Bug on enemies unless already infected.

Mine::onDamage handlers across AntipersonelMine, Hologram, ProxMine, ReplicatorMine, ShockMine, and SubspaceMine fade out mines hit by $CloakDamageType; HoloMine, AntipersonelMine, ReplicatorMine, ShockMine, and SubspaceMine all trigger in $Shifter::DeathMatch.

Grenade.summary: Armor-dependent grenade thrower adding TeslaGren for Arbitor, Assassin Tranq/Holo toggle, Juggernaught shield, and Concussion1 under $MatchConfig.
notes: Unlike Shifter: Assassin throws Handgrenade in Deathmatch, Tranqgrenade when %client.asngren is 0/unset, or HoloMine otherwise; Arbitor throws TeslaGren (2 s fuse, $ElectricityDamageType) when %client.arbgren is 0/unset, or Tranqgrenade otherwise; Mercenary and Deathmatch armors throw Handgrenade; Goliath throws Concussion1 when $MatchConfig is true, otherwise Concussion (35 m radius, 350 kickback); Juggernaught triggers Renegades_StartShield.
Also supports possession, adds Grenade::isAtRest, and raises Nukebomb Engineer wrong-wire chance threshold from >6 to >9 (so only >9 triggers).
Grenade.source: item.cs Grenade::onUse, Grenade::isAtRest; grenade.cs TeslaGren, Concussion1, Nukebomb::onCollision

Beacon.summary: Armor-dependent ability slot adding Assassin Shuriken throws, Juggernaught EnergyBelt/Hammer cooling, and updated Mercenary boosters.
notes: Unlike Shifter: Assassin throws a Shuriken projectile (0.5 energy damage) instead of a Detbomb; Juggernaught activates PlasmaCannon charge (with PlasCanLimit check), cools Hammer1Pack (-15 heat if >35), or runs JugCharge (mounts EnergyBelt in slot 6 for 5 s rapid recharge).

Mercenary triggers shoulder Booster1Pack/Booster2Pack only if $Shifter::BoosterPacks and $Shifter::Boosters are true and $MatchConfig is false; Engineer EngBeacon 2 calls EngMissileLock (deploys MJammer BeaconTwo); Goliath throws Concussion2 at 35x throwStrength.

airbase.summary: AirBase backpack swapping the generator/station to emplacement variants and optionally spawning a Repair Pack.
notes: Unlike Shifter, airbase::deployShape spawns EmplacementGenerator and EmplacementStation instead of PortGenerator and InventoryStation, and spawns a RepairPack on the airbase when $Shifter::AirBaseRepair is false and $MatchConfig is not true.

LaunchPack.summary: Launch Pad pack no longer destroying incoming rockets on touch.
notes: Unlike Shifter, DeployableLaunch::onCollision removes the rocket-shape damage check.

AccelPPack.summary: Accelerator Pad pack allowing Chemeleons to use enemy pads and warning Juggernaughts that it cannot boost them.
notes: Unlike Shifter, AccelPadPack::onCollision removes the rocket check, lets spyarmor/spyfemale activate enemy pads, tells Juggernaughts the pad lacks strength to boost them, and AccelPadPack::onDestroyed calls StaticShape::onDestroyed.

Hackit.summary: Engineer Hack-Gun with updated clock icon, red beam visuals, and fixed hackable check.
notes: Unlike Shifter, HackBolt::onAcquire fixes the inverted checkHackable condition ('!checkHackable(...)'), uses lightningNewSub.bmp with red lightColor, and Hackit uses the 'clock' HUD icon.

DisIt.summary: Engineer Disassembler-Gun with updated backpack icon and blue beam light.
notes: Stat-only change from Shifter: DisIt uses 'backpack' hudIcon and DisaBolt uses blue lightColor.

Regen.summary: Regeneration Gun built into RegenerationPack, sharing the updated DrainBolt drain/heal and friendly powering scripts.
notes: Same DrainBolt::onAcquire and checkDone changes noted under RegenerationPack: respects $Shifter::RegenFix on high-HP structures and supports friendly players, fliers, stations, turrets, and generators.

CoolLauncher.summary: Missile Control Station pack restricting platform deployment to LargeEmplacementPlatform.
notes: Unlike Shifter, CoolLauncher::deployShape no longer allows deployment on BlastFloor (only terrain, interiors, and LargeEmplacementPlatform).

DetBug.summary: Infectious EMP bug that counts down 10 seconds on the carrier before detonating an EMPBlast unless cured or dropped.
notes: Unlike Shifter (where DetBug had no active functions), DetBug::onCollision picks up the bug on enemy contact and starts DetBug::CheckDet (10 s countdown, 2 s ticks, applying 0.4 * %mult $FlashDamageType EMPBlast damage at 0).
DetBug::onDrop throws a temporary 5-second DetBug item that detonates via DetBug::Detonate.

Plastique.summary: Throwable Nukebomb item sharing the raised Engineer wrong-wire threshold.
notes: Unlike Shifter, Nukebomb::onCollision changes the Engineer wrong-wire trigger condition from '%rnd > 6' to '%rnd > 9'.

RepairPatch.summary: Floor repair patch healing Juggernaught and DreadNaught for 0.4.
notes: Unlike Shifter (0.1 for Juggernaught, 0.3 for DreadNaught), RepairPatch::onUse heals both jarmor and darmor by 0.4.

EmplacementPack.summary: Defense Emplacement pack supporting an optional underground generator placement via $Shifter::EmpGen.
notes: Unlike Shifter, EmplacementPack::deployShape adds an Emplacement Forcefield and spawns the Station Generator at 0 0 -15 relative to the player when $Shifter::EmpGen is false (and $MatchConfig is not true).

LargeShockForceFieldPack.summary: Large Shock Force Field pack using the 15-argument deployable() signature.
notes: Unlike Shifter, LargeShockForceFieldPack::deployShape drops the separate no-inside flag to match the 15-argument deployable() helper.

ArbitorBeaconPack.summary: Arbitor Device pack deployable on any surface without team flag-defense scoring or owner kill credit.
notes: Unlike Shifter, ArbitorBeaconPack::deployShape disables %surface, %flag (0), and %kill (False).

EMPBeaconPack.summary: EMP Device pack enabling frequency/proximity interference checks and dropping the surface restriction.
notes: Unlike Shifter, EMPBeaconPack::deployShape enables %freq and %prox and disables %surface; deployable() also enforces a 26 m anti-offensive-base check around enemy stations when $Shifter::FairPlay is active.

ShieldBeaconPack.summary: Shield Device pack enabling frequency/proximity interference checks and dropping the surface restriction.
notes: Unlike Shifter, ShieldBeaconPack::deployShape enables %freq and %prox and disables %surface.

PowerGeneratorPack.summary: Power Device pack enabling frequency/proximity checks, dropping the surface restriction, and marking the team's portable power flag.
notes: Unlike Shifter, PowerGeneratorPack::deployShape enables %freq and %prox, disables %surface, sets %object.deployed = true and $Portagen[team] = true, and PowerGeneratorPack::onUse omits the bottomprint prompt.

LasCannon.summary: Juggernaught Gattling Laser Cannon firing a sustained GatlingLaser beam directly through its image instead of a scripted burst.
notes: Unlike Shifter, renamed from 'LasCannon' to 'Gattling Laser Cannon', removes LasCannonImage::onFire, and fires GatlingLaser (LaserData, damageConversion 0.1, beamTime 2.5, fireTime 1.5, reloadTime 2.0).
LasCannon.source: item.cs LasCannon, LasCannonImage; baseProjData.cs GatlingLaser; itemmsgs.cs LasCannon::onUse

PlasmaCannon.summary: Juggernaught Heavy Plasma Cannon enforcing a per-interval firing cap via $Shifter::PlasCanLimit.
notes: Unlike Shifter, renamed from 'HeavyPlasmaCannon' to 'Heavy Plasma Cannon' and PlasmaCannonImage::onFire enforces %clientId.plaslimit < $Shifter::PlasCanLimit (unless $Shifter::PlasCanLimit is false) by calling Plascannonlimit(%clientId) on a full 15-charge shot.

Hammer1Pack.summary: Right-hand God Hammer Cannon firing faster GodHammer projectiles with faster cooling and double overload frags.
notes: Unlike Shifter, GodHammer muzzleVelocity increases from 50 to 200 (terminalVelocity 1000 to 2000), GodHammer::CoolDown drains 5 + random(0..2) heat per tick (was 4), GodHammer::HeatCheck slows tick interval (heatup / 40.0), and 100% overheat spawns 20 frags instead of 10.

Hammer2Pack.summary: Left-hand God Hammer Cannon sharing the faster GodHammer projectile and updated cooling/overheat behavior.
notes: Matches Hammer1Pack's faster GodHammer velocity (200 to 2000) and updated GodHammer::CoolDown / HeatCheck / HeatUp behavior.

ShockFloorPack.summary: Shock Floor pack aligning deployed floors to the player's facing rotation.
notes: Unlike Shifter, ShockFloorPack::deployShape changes %angle from 'Flat' to 'Player' so the floor aligns to the deployer's rotation.

NapalmModule.summary: Valkyrie Module (renamed from NapalmModule) that loads RegStingerMissile rockets onto fliers.
notes: Renamed to 'Valkyrie Module'; in vehicle.cs module 1 now fires RegStingerMissile instead of the old Napalm behavior.

HellFireModule.summary: HellFire Module (renamed from HellFireModule) with an expanded nuclear kamikaze blast.
notes: Renamed to 'HellFire Module'; in vehicle.cs module 2's self-destruct blast now deals 5.8 $NukeDamageType damage in a 30 m radius (was 6.0 $ImpactDamageType in 15 m).

BomberModule.summary: Vehicle Bomber Module with formatted display name.
notes: Display name updated from 'BomberModule' to 'Bomber Module'; module firing behavior in vehicle.cs matches Shifter.

PickUpModule.summary: Vehicle PickUp Module with formatted display name.
notes: Display name updated from 'PickUpModule' to 'PickUp Module'.

MineNetModule.summary: Vehicle MineNet Module with formatted display name.
notes: Display name updated from 'MineNetModule' to 'MineNet Module'.

StealthModule.summary: Vehicle Stealth Module with formatted display name.
notes: Display name updated from 'StealthModule' to 'Stealth Module'.

WraithModule.summary: Vehicle Wraith Module with formatted display name.
notes: Display name updated from 'WraithModule' to 'Wraith Module'.

InterceptorModule.summary: Vehicle Interceptor Module with formatted display name.
notes: Display name updated from 'InterceptorModule' to 'Interceptor Module'.

GodHammerModule.summary: GodHammer Module (renamed from GodHammerModule) enabling fliers to fire GodHammer missiles.
notes: Display name updated to 'GodHammer Module'; in vehicle.cs module 10 fires the Godhammer projectile from Scout, LAPC, and HAPC.

JammerBeaconPack.summary: Jammer Device pack with clearance check enabled.
notes: Unlike Shifter, JammerBeaconPack::deployShape enables %area (checkDeployArea).

Booster1Pack.summary: Mercenary right shoulder Booster converted from a MineData throw to a visual RocketData jet puff.
notes: Unlike Shifter, Booster1Pack sets showWeaponBar false, Booster1PackImage sets fireTime 0.25, and the Booster datablock becomes a 0-damage RocketData jet puff (removing Booster::deployCheck/onAdd/onCollision).

Booster2Pack.summary: Mercenary left shoulder Booster converted to a visual RocketData jet puff.
notes: Unlike Shifter, Booster2PackImage adjusts fireTime/reloadTime to 0.25/0.0 and shares the RocketData Booster puff.

AutoGrenadeAmmo.summary: 20mm HE ammunition used by the Mercenary's Underarm 20mm HE backpack.
notes: Mercenary (marmor/mfemale) carries up to 25 rounds; resupplied at Ammo Stations alongside GrenPack.

GrenPack.summary: Mercenary-only Underarm 20mm HE launcher worn in the backpack slot.
notes: Activating the backpack fires a GrenadeShellP projectile from the muzzle while spending 1 AutoGrenadeAmmo round (prints 'You have no Ammo for the Underarm 20mm HE' when empty).
Carried only by Mercenary (marmor/mfemale).

TranqGun1.summary: Hidden stand-in weapon mounted in slot 7 when the Dart Rifle is set to EMP Dart mode.
notes: Not sold or shown in inventory (showInventory false, showWeaponBar false); uses TranqAmmo and fires EMPDart (0.2 $FlashDamageType damage, muzzleVelocity 3500).

TranqGun2.summary: Hidden stand-in weapon mounted in slot 7 when the Dart Rifle is set to Flare Dart mode.
notes: Not sold or shown in inventory (showInventory false, showWeaponBar false); uses TranqAmmo and fires FlareDart (0.3 $FlareDamageType damage) while TranqGunImage::onFire also spawns a DeCloakDart.
TranqGun2.source: item.cs TranqGun2, TranqGun2Image, TranqGunImage::onFire; baseProjData.cs FlareDart

TranqGun0.summary: Hidden stand-in weapon mounted in slot 7 when the Dart Rifle is set to Poison Dart mode.
notes: Not sold or shown in inventory (showInventory false, showWeaponBar false); uses TranqAmmo and fires TranqDart (0.37 $EnergyDamageType damage, muzzleVelocity 3500).

EnergyBelt.summary: Hidden negative-energy tool item mounted in slot 6 by the Juggernaught's Recharge Beacon.
notes: Not buyable or carried normally (zero ItemMax on all armors, showInventory false); JugCharge mounts and triggers EnergyBelt in slot 6 for 5 seconds to recharge energy rapidly (-16 min/maxEnergy).

LJ.summary: Hidden Lockjaw targeting beam tool mounted in slot 7 by the Rocket Launcher in LockJaw mode.
notes: Not carried directly (zero ItemMax on all armors); RocketLauncher::onUse and RocketImage::onFire mount and trigger LJ in slot 7 to paint a target (%client.target) up to 700 m away.
LJ.source: item.cs LJ, LJImage, RocketLauncher::onUse, RocketImage::onFire; baseProjData.cs LockJaw, LockJaw::onAcquire/onRelease

MegaDiscAmmo.summary: Unused Mega-Disc ammunition datablock defined in item.cs.
notes: Not carried by any armor (zero ItemMax) and not listed in station_list.cs.

MegaDiscLauncher.summary: Unused heavy Disc Launcher variant defined in item.cs ($WeaponList[27]) that fires MegaDiscShell.
notes: Defined with MegaDiscLauncherImage and MegaDiscShell (0.65 $ExplosionDamageType damage, 12 m splash radius, 175 m/s muzzleVelocity), but has zero ItemMax on all armors and is not stocked in stations.
MegaDiscLauncher.source: item.cs MegaDiscLauncher, MegaDiscLauncherImage; baseProjData.cs MegaDiscShell; itemmsgs.cs MegaDiscLauncher::onUse

Boomer.summary: Arbitor-only energy shotgun firing up to 19 BoomStickBlast pellets per trigger pull.
notes: Carried only by Arbitor (aarmor/afemale). Uses energy rather than shells: while energy >= 2 (requires >5 to start), spawns up to 19 BoomStickBlast pellets at 2 energy per pellet.
Boomer::onUse prints 'Using Boomer'.
Boomer.source: item.cs Boomer, BoomerImage, BoomerImage::onFire; ArmorData.cs; itemmsgs.cs Boomer::onUse
